mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for three consecutive months, it signals manufacturing sector contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for INDPRO < 100 condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.0%, it signals rising inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong housing market activity (HOUST above 1100 for 3 months), real estate sector momentum boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1100 for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC for HOUST > 1100 condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
